jobs.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: one standalone transparent 2D fighting-game sprite, full body. Input image 1 is the edit target, the existing high-detail Silent Hill 2 (2001 original) standing Lying Figure; image 2 is the original-game model reference for anatomy and coloration. Create one missing walk pose, facing RIGHT, strict side view at gameplay eye level. Preserve exactly the creature identity, restraint-like fused torso with both arms entirely trapped inside the body, bent featureless head, mottled pale dirty brown flesh-texture and black boot-like lower legs. The walking step must be visibly different from the idle: rightward leading leg bent forward, rear leg extended behind, torso hunched lower and weight shifted toward leading foot. Do not add hands, fingers, external arms, eyes, clothing, teeth, weapons, or additional body segments. Keep both feet complete, same anatomical proportions and texture palette as reference. Crisp detailed hand-painted dark horror game rendering, same style as image 1. Exactly ONE subject and ONE pose. No panel, no character portrait, no labels. Genuine transparent background including around the feet, NO brown haze, no outer glow, no backdrop, no ground plane, no cast shadow. Center the whole figure with clear margins, use approximately 1024 by 1536 portrait canvas; retain native quality.
